title: Historical bowling data source clearance registry
policy: Source visibility ≠ permission to redistribute. Only licensed records are eligible for the open/public warehouse. Unverified sources may be assessed via metadata and schema, but original rows are not automatically imported.

sources.name: Cricsheet bowling scorecards and deliveries
sources.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
sources.notes: Existing licensed men/women scorecard warehouse, immutable snapshots.

sources.name: Cricsheet people and venue registers
sources.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
sources.notes: Does not supply bowler bowling-style, venue physical country, or verified cricket host.

sources.name: Wikidata structured bowling style and ground geography
sources.coverage: Sparse: only subset of Cricsheet identities
sources.notes: Official country of play NOT inferred from physical country; name ambiguity kept unknown.

sources.name: MPCMP Test bowling dataset (Philipson)
sources.license: No explicit license observed in GitHub repository
dataTypes: opposition and game-context covariates as described by study
sources.downloadAction: Do not upload to public warehouse; request explicit data reuse and redistribution permission; then independently validate provenance.

sources.name: 2017 historical bowling figures (Duncan Golicher)
sources.license: Package DESCRIPTION says 'License: What license is it under?'; source explicitly ESPN-derived
sources.coverage: Test, ODI, T20I records through 20 August 2017
sources.downloadAction: Author permission alone may not clear ESPN database rights; require a documented reuse basis covering third-party source rights.

sources.name: Historical Test scorecard CSV (Hugging Face)
sources.license: No license on dataset card or repository files observed
sources.downloadAction: Seek uploader/source permission and provenance, validate match census, inspect known dataset viewer schema cast issue.

sources.name: Howstat, CricketArchive, CricArcade, ESPN, Cricket Database
sources.coverage: Older historical scorecards and career references
sources.downloadAction: Reference for validation only unless licensed; do not scrape systematically.

acceptanceCriteria: Dataset provenance and license/legal basis reviewed and recorded per source and version.
Historical scorecards only joined on stable player/match IDs or independently validated keys.
Per-format and per-year completeness checked against a distinct reference match census.
Pre-Cricsheet legends (Barnes, Marshall, Laker, Grimmett, Hadlee, Warne, Murali, McGrath) audited for full-career innings/wickets.
Overlapping modern and historic records deduplicated by match/innings, not blindly concatenated.
Commercial/third-party terms explicitly considered before redistributing rows to GitHub/public app.
Separate bowling dataset; leave batting app, model and public data untouched.
